docs.summary: A drawable icon. Widgets hand it a rect + colour and it paints itself onto the canvas, so the same widget chrome works with vector (SVG) icons, glyph-font icons (Font Awesome, etc.) or any custom drawing. Implement this to supply your own icon set; Origami ships [`SvgIcon`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.SvgIcon), [`FontIcon`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.FontIcon) and [`IconAction`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.IconAction), and a default set on [`OrigamiIcons`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiIcons).

members.name: Draw
members.signature: void Draw(Canvas canvas, Rect rect, Color color, float strokeWidth = 1.5f)

docs.summary: Paint the icon inside `rect`. `color` is the colour the host wants (e.g. the current text/hover colour); an icon may honour it or use its own.
